decisions.summary: Convert native runtime probe dry-run plans into operator-approved playbooks for manual worktree, dynamic workflow, and agent-team lifecycles without enabling default auto-execution.

expected_metrics.target: pass for committed native runtime probe fixtures
at least 9.5/10 after operator-approved recipes are CI-visible

verification_commands.expected: status pass with auto_executable_recipes 0 and irreversible_actions 0

observed_results.summary: P23 adds a read-only native runtime playbook gate, schema, operator docs, CI step, and explicit approval/cleanup recipes.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step and playbook gate if the recipes prove misleading; follow up with an explicit apply-mode launcher only after operator-approved runs produce useful evidence.
